summary: @servicetitan/html-sketchapp preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v${V}/ into a tempdir, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [<pkg>/math_init.js])`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array/index-shuffle obfuscation with hex-named identifiers (WV8StW rotator, n7gIxM lookup array); its contents are opaque and unrelated to the package's advertised HTML-to-Sketch conversion purpose. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope, but package.json `author`, `repository`, and `homepage` point to `brainly/html-sketchapp` (Konrad Dzwinel); the upstream brainly package ships neither a preinstall hook, setup.mjs, nor math_init.js — these files are injected on top of an otherwise legitimate fork. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: fetching a second language runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated blob at install time gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on any machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
